about: The only place an affiliate URL lives. One slot per streaming service, filled by Jack (J-3) with the tracking link the affiliate network gives him, through Impact. A slot with an empty url prints the service's plain link and nothing else; a filled slot prints this url with rel="sponsored nofollow noopener" and puts the how-we-make-money line in that page's footer. Add a service by adding a slot. `names` are the labels the where-to-watch rows print, matched without case and without any parenthetical. Never typed in by a builder.
